title: Gateway staging, SQL Server CDC: txnID is always "0"

found.by: lfc-schema-change-test gateway-staging samples: SQL Server 2022 CU27, standard CDC, utility 1.7, serverless gateway

symptom: every change record has txnID "0", including the 4 records of one multi-statement transaction
cause: the field isn't filled for SQL Server CDC; the transaction is in the sequence instead (~v00001-<commit LSN>-<counter>)
effect: grouping or ordering by txnID merges every transaction into one
fix: group by the commit LSN part of cursor.sequence, order by its counter
